description: Adobe Experience Platform Real-Time Customer Profile panel, exact match to the KSIA reference, upgraded 20 Jul 2026 to the full timeline plus PROGRESSIVE story-time. Adobe Experience Cloud header; REAL-TIME CUSTOMER PROFILE band with customer-profile (photo, fields, consent checks), identity (Desktop/Mobile/Email/ECID/CRM IDs) and segmentation cards; EXPERIENCE EVENTS band with an icon interaction grid on dotted timelines (web/email/mail-open/phone/mirror/qr). Adobe product UI in FIXED dark neutrals (Adobe-surface exception) - parameterize DATA ONLY via AEP_DATA, never rebrand colours; blue is Adobe's own product accent. Every field/identity/segment/event carries a `step` (the story checkpoint that first captured it); AEP.setStep(n)/next()/prev()/all() shows the profile AS IT STOOD at checkpoint n, newly captured items glowing in. Drop it at every 'cut to the platform' beat of a journey deck, each call to a later step; on load it renders the full profile (the static reference).
slots: persona-photo (Firefly/persona repo; sample uses a silhouette placeholder)
pipeline: DERIVED, LATE STEP. AEP_DATA is not authored by hand; it is derived from the finished storyboard, so it runs near the end of the build (after the storyboard is validated and the deck's checkpoints are known). Walk the beats once: each touchpoint beat becomes an EVENT (icon by channel), each personal detail the customer reveals becomes a PROFILE FIELD, each identity stitched (web cookie/app id/ECID/CRM) becomes an IDENTITY, each qualifying behaviour (books, passes, shows interest, purchases, becomes loyal) becomes a SEGMENT. Tag every item with the checkpoint (writer marks which beats 'cut to the platform'); set maxStep to the number of checkpoints. The deck then drops this panel at each checkpoint slide and calls AEP.setStep(k). Proposed builder step id: aep_profile.
